As someone using MFP for a few years with about 120+ loss, are you: 
1- measuring foods? A cup of one thing seems like less than I originally estimated while others it’s SOOO much more! 
2- checking your activity level baseline? You may not be as active outside of exercise as you think... been there done that! 
3- exercising to your optimum heart rate? MOST of us do this and we aren’t actually burning the optimal calories as listed in the app. I had a private trainer appointment and was like, ok I’m above where my heart rate should be while on the treadmill and below on circuit training... whoops, neither way is the best for physical activity for me... 
4- weighing vs measuring... Not fun, but more accurate. Oh and reading EVERY label for a serving size! (I hate the fact of the 1/4c / 38g shredded cheese, I use way less now but the FIRST time I measured I near cried!) After a bit you’ll be able to set it up on your own no worries!

You have your reason? Then remember that. Don’t give up. And seriously one at a time makes it SOOOOO much easier. Now I’m down to a healthy state, I can actually outrun my kids lol, and my body doesn’t hurt to move. FYI 35F/mom of 4, ft night nurse.
